name: City of Dublin Volunteer Program (Community Programs, Special Events, Sports Leagues)
org: City of Dublin Parks and Community Services
what_you_do: Help at the Dublin Senior Center or Heritage Park and Museum on a set weekly shift. Or help at city events like Splatter and the St. Patrick's Day Festival. Or coach, ref or keep score for kids' sports.
who_can_apply: Ages 14 and up for Community Programs, Special Events and Sports Leagues. You do not have to live in Dublin. Volunteers under 18 need a signed parent consent form. Younger kids can join park cleanup projects with an adult.
duration: Community Programs: ongoing, a set day and shift weekly, every other week or monthly (Senior Center shifts are usually 2 to 4 hours). Special Events: one-time shifts. Sports: one season.
deadline_text: Ongoing. The Community Programs Volunteer posting opened Aug 13, 2026 and lists no closing date.
how_to_apply: Apply online through the city's volunteer posting (you make a free account). Staff review your application within 2 business days and reply within 8 business days. Then go to orientation and start your shift. Questions: recreation@dublin.ca.gov or (925) 556-4500.
notes: The city guide says Splatter (September) has short shifts that are good for teens. Volunteer coaches must have AED certification. Staff can write a letter verifying your hours for school or clubs; allow 5 to 7 business days. The Special Events listing on the volunteer page said 'currently unavailable' on Oct 16, 2026.
